blurb: Keep Austin Wet offers a fleet of party boats, pontoons, and wakesurf boats for rent on Lake Travis. Every rental includes a professional captain, fuel, life jackets, and safety equipment. Boats depart from Volente Beach Resort & Waterpark, which provides parking, food, and free waterpark access for guests.

quotes.author: Shawna Denkhaus
quotes.text: When can we take out the double decker again?!?! 2 water slides, great speakers, super clean, super roomy, paddle boards, lily pad, coolers, and Erin was a great captain! Perfect summer Saturday!

quotes.author: Kathryn Cawley
quotes.text: Perfect for bachelorette weekend! Fun and knowledgeable captain, competitive prices, fun day in the water; what more could you ask for? I would definitely recommend Keep Austin Wet!

quotes.author: Molly Spalt
quotes.text: The best boat experience ever!!! Loudest speakers on lake Travis!!! Everyone came on our boat!!!! What a party!!!!

quotes.author: David Hernandez
quotes.text: Our bachelor reconsidered his engagement on this trip. 10/10 recommend
